bmr.description: ...is a death extravaganza. Demons kill multiple times per night, and Minions get in on the action too. Good players can take great risks to gain reliable information, but may accidentally kill their friends in the process. Luckily, there are many ways to keep players alive long past their use-by date. If the good team cannot determine which Minions and Demons are in play, however, their doom is all but certain.
bmr.name: Bad Moon Rising

custom.description: To play with a custom script, you need to select the characters you want to play with in the official Script Tool and then upload the generated "custom-list.json" either directly here or provide a URL to such a hosted JSON file. To load it, you can also drag & drop the script file onto this screen or paste the JSON from your clipboard.
custom.name: Custom Script

snv.description: ...is the craziest of the three editions included in the base set. Good characters get amazing information each and every night. However, the evil team is extremely varied and threatening and can throw massive confusion into the mix. Characters change alignment. Players change characters. Even the evil team can lose track of who is who. This is also the first appearance of madness, which throws all manner of spanners into the works.
snv.name: Sects & Violets

tb.description:
...has a little bit of everything. Some characters passively receive information, some need to take action to learn who is who, while some simply want to bait the Demon into attacking them. Both good and evil can gain the upper hand by making well-timed sacrifices.
Trouble Brewing is a relatively straightforward Demon hunt, but evil has a number of dastardly misinformation tricks up their sleeves, so the good players had better question what they think they know if they hope to survive.
tb.name: Trouble Brewing

jinxes.alchemist-boffin: If the Alchemist has the Boffin ability, the Alchemist does not learn what ability the Demon has.
jinxes.alchemist-marionette: An Alchemist-Marionette has no Marionette ability & the Marionette is in play.
jinxes.alchemist-mastermind: An Alchemist-Mastermind has no Mastermind ability & the Mastermind is not-in-play.
jinxes.alchemist-organgrinder: If the Alchemist has the Organ Grinder ability, the Organ Grinder is in play. If both are sober, both are drunk.
jinxes.alchemist-spy: An Alchemist-Spy has no Spy ability & a Spy is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Spy may publicly guess a living player as the Spy. If correct, the Demon must choose the Spy tonight.
jinxes.alchemist-summoner: The Alchemist-Summoner does not get bluffs, and chooses which Demon but not which player. If they die before this happens, evil wins. [No Demon]
jinxes.alchemist-widow: An Alchemist-Widow has no Widow ability & a Widow is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Widow may publicly guess a living player as the Widow. If correct, the Demon must choose the Widow tonight.
jinxes.alchemist-wraith: An Alchemist-Wraith has no Wraith ability & a Wraith is in play. After each execution, a living Alchemist-Wraith may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Demon must choose the Wraith tonight.
jinxes.alhadikhia-mastermind: If the Al-Hadikhia dies by execution, and the Mastermind is alive, the Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 good players tonight: if all 3 choose to live, evil wins. Otherwise, good wins.
jinxes.alhadikhia-princess: If the Princess nominated & executed a player on their 1st day, no one dies to the Al-Hadikhia tonight.
jinxes.alhadikhia-scarletwoman: If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
jinxes.alsaahir-vizier: The Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
jinxes.atheist-riot: During a riot, if the Storyteller is nominated, players vote. If they are "about to die", the game ends. If not, they nominate again.
jinxes.balloonist-marionette: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, an Outsider might have been added during setup.
jinxes.banshee-leviathan: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
jinxes.banshee-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Banshee dies & gains their ability.
jinxes.banshee-vortox: If the Vortox kills the Banshee, all players learn that the Banshee has died.
jinxes.baron-heretic: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.baron-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Baron ability, up to two players become Outsiders.
jinxes.boffin-cultleader: If the Demon has the Cult Leader ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
jinxes.boffin-drunk: The Demon cannot have the Drunk ability.
jinxes.boffin-goon: If the Demon has the Goon ability, they can’t turn good due to this ability.
jinxes.boffin-heretic: The Demon cannot have the Heretic ability.
jinxes.boffin-ogre: The Demon cannot have the Ogre ability.
jinxes.boffin-politician: The Demon cannot have the Politician ability.
jinxes.boffin-villageidiot: If there is a spare token, the Boffin can give the Demon the Village Idiot ability.
jinxes.boomdandy-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Boomdandy ability, a player becomes the Boomdandy.
jinxes.bountyhunter-kazali: If the Kazali turns the Bounty Hunter into a Minion, an evil Townsfolk is not created.
jinxes.bountyhunter-philosopher: If the Philosopher gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.
jinxes.butler-cannibal: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
jinxes.butler-organgrinder: If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Butler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.
jinxes.cannibal-juggler: If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.
jinxes.cannibal-princess: If the Cannibal nominated, executed, & killed the Princess today, the Demon doesn’t kill tonight.
jinxes.cannibal-zealot: If the Cannibal gains the Zealot ability, the Cannibal learns this.
jinxes.cerenovus-goblin: The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin.
jinxes.chambermaid-mathematician: The Chambermaid can detect if the Mathematician will wake tonight.
jinxes.clockmaker-summoner: The Summoner registers as the Demon to the Clockmaker.
jinxes.courtier-summoner: If the living Summoner has no ability, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
jinxes.courtier-vizier: If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
jinxes.cultleader-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Cult Leader, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
jinxes.damsel-pithag: If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
jinxes.damsel-spy: If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
jinxes.damsel-widow: If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
jinxes.drunk-mathematician: The Mathematician learns if the Drunk’s ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
jinxes.engineer-legion: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Engineer starts knowing this but has no ability.
jinxes.engineer-summoner: If the living Summoner is removed from play, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
jinxes.eviltwin-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Evil Twin ability, a player becomes the Evil Twin.
jinxes.exorcist-leviathan: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
jinxes.exorcist-riot: If Riot nominates and executes the Exorcist-chosen player, good wins.
jinxes.exorcist-yaggababble: If the Exorcist chooses the Yaggababble, the Yaggababble does not kill tonight.
jinxes.fanggu-scarletwoman: If there would be two Demons, one of which was the Scarlet Woman, the Scarlet Woman remains the Scarlet Woman.
jinxes.farmer-leviathan: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.farmer-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.fearmonger-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Fearmonger ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
jinxes.fearmonger-vizier: The Vizier wakes with the Fearmonger, learns who they choose and cannot choose to immediately execute that player.
jinxes.goblin-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Goblin ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
jinxes.godfather-heretic: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.goon-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Goon, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
jinxes.grandmother-leviathan: If the Leviathan is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
jinxes.grandmother-riot: If Riot is in play and the Grandchild dies by execution, evil wins.
jinxes.hatter-legion: If Legion is created, all evil players become Legion. If Legion is in play, the Hatter has no ability.
jinxes.hatter-leviathan: The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
jinxes.hatter-lilmonsta: If the Hatter dies & the Demon chooses Lil' Monsta, they also choose a Minion to become.
jinxes.hatter-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
jinxes.heretic-lleech: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.heretic-pithag: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.heretic-spy: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.heretic-widow: Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
jinxes.huntsman-marionette: If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added during setup.
jinxes.innkeeper-leviathan: If the Leviathan nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
jinxes.innkeeper-riot: If Riot nominates and executes an Innkeeper-protected player, good wins.
jinxes.investigator-vizier: The Storyteller doesn't declare the Vizier is in play.
jinxes.kazali-marionette: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
jinxes.kazali-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
jinxes.king-leviathan: If the Leviathan is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
jinxes.king-riot: If Riot is in play, and at least 1 player is dead, the King learns an alive character each night.
jinxes.legion-magician: If the Magician is in play, during the Demon info step, Legion wake in separate groups. Each group learns which players are good, but does not learn the Magician.
jinxes.legion-minstrel: If Legion died by execution today, Legion keeps their ability, but the Minstrel might learn they are Legion.
jinxes.legion-politician: The Politician might register as evil to Legion.
jinxes.legion-preacher: If the Preacher chooses Legion, Legion keeps their ability, but the Preacher might learn they are Legion.
jinxes.legion-summoner: If Legion is summoned, all evil players become Legion.
jinxes.legion-zealot: The Zealot might register as evil to Legion.
jinxes.leviathan-mayor: If the Leviathan and the Mayor are alive on day 5 & no execution occurs, good wins.
jinxes.leviathan-monk: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
jinxes.leviathan-pithag: The Leviathan cannot enter play after day 5.
jinxes.leviathan-ravenkeeper: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.leviathan-sage: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.leviathan-soldier: If the Leviathan nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
jinxes.lilmonsta-magician: If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
jinxes.lilmonsta-marionette: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
jinxes.lilmonsta-poppygrower: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
jinxes.lilmonsta-psychopath: If the Psychopath is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
jinxes.lilmonsta-scarletwoman: If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, the Scarlet Woman babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game.
jinxes.lilmonsta-vizier: If the Vizier is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.
jinxes.lleech-mastermind: If the Mastermind is alive and the Lleech host dies by execution, the Lleech lives but loses their ability.
jinxes.lleech-slayer: If the Slayer slays the Lleech host, the host dies.
jinxes.lordoftyphon-summoner: If a Lord of Typhon is summoned, they must neighbor a Minion & their other neighbor becomes an evil Minion.
jinxes.lunatic-mathematician: The Mathematician learns if the Lunatic attacks a different player than the real Demon attacked.
jinxes.magician-marionette: If the Magician is alive, the Demon doesn't know which neighbor is the Marionette.
jinxes.magician-spy: When the Spy sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
jinxes.magician-vizier: If the Vizier is in play, the Magician has no ability but is immune to the Vizier's ability.
jinxes.magician-widow: When the Widow sees the Grimoire, the Demon and Magician's character tokens are removed.
jinxes.magician-wraith: After each execution, the living Magician may publicly guess a living player as the Wraith. If correct, the Demon must choose the Wraith tonight.
jinxes.marionette-mathematician: The Mathematician learns if the Marionette’s ability yielded false info or failed to work properly.
jinxes.marionette-plaguedoctor: If the Storyteller would gain the Marionette ability, one of the Demon's good neighbors becomes the Marionette.
jinxes.marionette-summoner: If there would be a Marionette in play, they enter play after the Demon & must start as their neighbor.
jinxes.mastermind-vigormortis: A Mastermind that has their ability keeps it if the Vigormortis dies.
jinxes.mayor-riot: The Mayor may choose to stop the riot. If they do so when only 1 Riot is alive, good wins. Otherwise, evil wins.
jinxes.monk-riot: If Riot nominates and executes the Monk-protected player, good wins.
jinxes.ogre-pithag: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Ogre, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
jinxes.ogre-recluse: If the Recluse registers as evil to the Ogre, the Ogre learns that they are evil.
jinxes.ogre-spy: The Spy registers as evil to the Ogre.
jinxes.pithag-politician: If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Politician, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
jinxes.pithag-summoner: If the Summoner creates a second living Demon, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
jinxes.pithag-villageidiot: If there is a spare token, the Pit-Hag can create an extra Village Idiot. If so, the drunk Village Idiot might change.
jinxes.plaguedoctor-scarletwoman: If the Storyteller would gain the Scarlet Woman ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
jinxes.plaguedoctor-spy: If the Storyteller would gain the Spy ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
jinxes.plaguedoctor-wraith: If the Storyteller would gain the Wraith ability, a Minion gains it, and learns this.
jinxes.politician-vizier: The Politician might register as evil to the Vizier.
jinxes.poppygrower-spy: If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Spy does not see the Grimoire.
jinxes.poppygrower-summoner: If the Poppy Grower is alive on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon but not which player.
jinxes.poppygrower-widow: If the Poppy Grower has their ability, the Widow does not see the Grimoire.
jinxes.preacher-summoner: If the living Summoner has no ability, the Storyteller has the Summoner ability.
jinxes.preacher-vizier: If the Vizier loses their ability, they learn this, and cannot die during the day.
jinxes.pukka-summoner: The Summoner may summon a Pukka on the 2nd night instead of the 3rd.
jinxes.ravenkeeper-riot: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.recluse-sage: The Recluse might register as the Demon to the Sage.
jinxes.riot-sage: Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Sage uses their ability but does not die.
jinxes.riot-soldier: If Riot nominates and executes the Soldier, good wins.
jinxes.summoner-zombuul: If the Summoner summons a dead player into the Zombuul, the Zombuul has already "died once".
jinxes.vizier-zealot: The Zealot might register as evil to the Vizier.

acrobat.ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they are or become drunk or poisoned tonight, you die.
acrobat.name: Acrobat

alchemist.ability: You have a Minion ability. When using this, the Storyteller may prompt you to choose differently.
alchemist.first: Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Minion token.
alchemist.name: Alchemist

alhadikhia.ability: Each night*, you may choose 3 players (all players learn who): each silently chooses to live or die, but if all live, all die.
alhadikhia.name: Al-Hadikhia
alhadikhia.other: The Al-Hadikhia chooses 3 players. :reminder: :reminder: :reminder: In order, wake each target. They nod or shake their head. Put them to sleep before waking the next target.

alsaahir.ability: Each day, if you publicly guess which players are Minion(s) and which are Demon(s), good wins.
alsaahir.name: Alsaahir

amnesiac.ability: You do not know what your ability is. Each day, privately guess what it is: you learn how accurate you are.
amnesiac.first: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.
amnesiac.name: Amnesiac
amnesiac.other: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Amnesiac's ability.

angel.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.
angel.first: Announce which players are protected by the Angel. :reminder:
angel.name: Angel

apprentice.ability: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good), or a Minion ability (if evil).
apprentice.first: Show the *YOU ARE* info token, then a Townsfolk or Minion token. Swap the Apprentice & Townsfolk or Minion tokens. :reminder:
apprentice.name: Apprentice

artist.ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
artist.name: Artist

assassin.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player: they die, even if for some reason they could not.
assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.other: The Assassin might choose a player. :reminder: :reminder:

atheist.ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules, and if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
atheist.name: Atheist

balloonist.ability: Each night, you learn a player of a different character type than last night. [+0 or +1 Outsider]
balloonist.name: Balloonist
balloonist.other: Point to a player with a different character type to the previously shown player. :reminder:

banshee.ability: If the Demon kills you, all players learn this. From now on, you may nominate twice per day and vote twice per nomination.
banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.other: If the Banshee was killed by the Demon tonight, announce that the Banshee has died. :reminder:

barber.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Demon may choose 2 players (not another Demon) to swap characters.
barber.name: Barber
barber.other: If the Barber died today or tonight, show the Demon the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barber tokens. If the Demon chose 2 players, wake one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

barista.ability: Each night, until dusk, 1) a player becomes sober, healthy & gets true info, or 2) their ability works twice. They learn which.
barista.first: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal. :reminder:
barista.name: Barista
barista.other: Choose a player. Wake them, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Barista tokens, then give a finger signal. :reminder:

baron.ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
baron.name: Baron

beggar.ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober & healthy.
beggar.name: Beggar

bigwig.ability: Each nominee chooses a player: until voting, only they may speak & they are mad the nominee is good or they might die.
bigwig.name: Big Wig

bishop.ability: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
bishop.name: Bishop

boffin.ability: The Demon (even if drunk or poisoned) has a not-in-play good character’s ability. You both know which.
boffin.first: Wake the Boffin and the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Boffin tokens, then the not-in-play good character token.
boffin.name: Boffin

bonecollector.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: they regain their ability until dusk.
bonecollector.name: Bone Collector
bonecollector.other: The Bone Collector might choose a dead player. :reminder: If necessary, wake the chosen player to use their ability.

boomdandy.ability: If you are executed, all but 3 players die. After a 10 to 1 countdown, the player with the most players pointing at them, dies.
boomdandy.name: Boomdandy

bootlegger.ability: This script has homebrew characters or rules.
bootlegger.name: Bootlegger

bountyhunter.ability: You start knowing 1 evil player. If the player you know dies, you learn another evil player tonight. [1 Townsfolk is evil]
bountyhunter.name: Bounty Hunter
bountyhunter.other: If the player marked *KNOW* died today or tonight, point to the new player marked *KNOW*.

buddhist.ability: For the first 2 minutes of each day, veteran players may not talk.
buddhist.first: Announce which players are affected by the Buddhist.
buddhist.name: Buddhist

bureaucrat.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
bureaucrat.name: Bureaucrat

butcher.ability: Each day, after the 1st execution, you may nominate again.
butcher.name: Butcher

butler.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
butler.name: Butler

cacklejack.ability: Each day, choose a player: a different player changes character tonight.
cacklejack.name: Cacklejack
cacklejack.other: Before dawn, choose a player not marked *NOT ME*. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

cannibal.ability: You have the ability of the recently killed executee. If they are evil, you are poisoned until a good player dies by execution.
cannibal.name: Cannibal

cerenovus.ability: Each night, choose a player & a good character: they are “mad” they are this character tomorrow, or might be executed.
cerenovus.first: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.
cerenovus.name: Cerenovus
cerenovus.other: The Cerenovus chooses a player & a character. :reminder: Put the Cerenovus to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Cerenovus token, then the madness-character token.

chambermaid.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
chambermaid.first: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.
chambermaid.name: Chambermaid
chambermaid.other: The Chambermaid chooses 2 living players. Give a finger signal.

chef.ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
chef.name: Chef

choirboy.ability: If the Demon kills the King, you learn which player is the Demon. [+the King]
choirboy.name: Choirboy
choirboy.other: If the Demon killed the King, point to the Demon player.

clockmaker.ability: You start knowing how many steps from the Demon to its nearest Minion.
clockmaker.name: Clockmaker

courtier.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a character: they are drunk for 3 nights & 3 days.
courtier.first: The Courtier might choose a character. :reminder: :reminder:
courtier.name: Courtier
courtier.other: The Courtier might choose a character. :reminder: :reminder:

cultleader.ability: Each night, you become the alignment of an alive neighbor. If all good players choose to join your cult, your team wins.
cultleader.first: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.
cultleader.name: Cult Leader
cultleader.other: The Cult Leader might change alignment. If so, show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumb signal.

damsel.ability: All Minions know a Damsel is in play. If a Minion publicly guesses you (once), your team loses.
damsel.first: During Minion Info, show the Minions the Damsel token. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
damsel.name: Damsel
damsel.other: If the Damsel was chosen by the Huntsman, show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

dawn.first: Wait for a few seconds. End the Night Phase.
dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.other: Wait for a few seconds. End the Night Phase.

demoninfo.first: If there are 7 or more players, wake the Demon: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to all Minions. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
demoninfo.name: Demon Info

deusexfiasco.ability: At least once per game, the Storyteller will make a mistake, correct it, and publicly admit to it.
deusexfiasco.name: Deus ex Fiasco

deviant.ability: If you were funny today, you cannot die by exile.
deviant.name: Deviant

devilsadvocate.ability: Each night, choose a living player (different to last night): if executed tomorrow, they don't die.
devilsadvocate.first: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player. :reminder:
devilsadvocate.name: Devil's Advocate
devilsadvocate.other: The Devil's Advocate chooses a living player. :reminder:

djinn.ability: Use the Djinn's special rule. All players know what it is.
djinn.name: Djinn

doomsayer.ability: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.
doomsayer.name: Doomsayer

dreamer.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself or Travellers): you learn 1 good & 1 evil character, 1 of which is correct.
dreamer.first: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.
dreamer.name: Dreamer
dreamer.other: The Dreamer points to a player. Show 1 good & 1 evil character token, 1 of which is their character.

drunk.ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
drunk.name: Drunk

duchess.ability: Each day, 3 players may choose to visit you. At night*, each visitor learns how many visitors are evil, but 1 gets false info.
duchess.name: Duchess
duchess.other: One at a time: Wake each player marked *VISITOR* or *FALSE INFO*. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Duchess tokens, then give a finger signal.

empath.ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
empath.name: Empath

engineer.ability: Once per game, at night, choose which Minions or which Demon is in play.
engineer.first: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:
engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.other: The Engineer might choose Minions or Demons. Put the Engineer to sleep. Wake the target(s) one at a time. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token. :reminder:

eviltwin.ability: You & an opposing player know each other. If the good player is executed, evil wins. Good can't win if you both live.
eviltwin.first: Wake both twins. Allow eye contact. Show the good twin's character token to the Evil Twin & vice versa.
eviltwin.name: Evil Twin

exorcist.ability: Each night*, choose a player (different to last night): the Demon, if chosen, learns who you are then doesn't wake tonight.
exorcist.name: Exorcist
exorcist.other: The Exorcist chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Exorcist to sleep. If the Exorcist chose the Demon: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens. Point to the Exorcist.

fanggu.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]
fanggu.name: Fang Gu
fanggu.other: The Fang Gu chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose an Outsider (once only): Replace the Outsider token with the spare Fang Gu token. Put the Fang Gu to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Fang Gu tokens & give a thumbs-down. :reminder:

farmer.ability: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.other: If the Farmer died tonight, wake a living good player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and a Farmer token.

fearmonger.ability: Each night, choose a player: if you nominate & execute them, their team loses. All players know if you choose a new player.
fearmonger.first: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: Announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.
fearmonger.name: Fearmonger
fearmonger.other: The Fearmonger chooses a player. :reminder: If the target is different to last night, announce that the Fearmonger has chosen a player.

ferryman.ability: On the final day, all dead players regain their vote token.
ferryman.name: Ferryman

fibbin.ability: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.
fibbin.name: Fibbin

fiddler.ability: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players choose which of these 2 players win.
fiddler.name: Fiddler

fisherman.ability: Once per game, during the day, visit the Storyteller for some advice to help your team win.
fisherman.name: Fisherman

flowergirl.ability: Each night*, you learn if a Demon voted today.
flowergirl.name: Flowergirl
flowergirl.other: Either nod or shake your head.

fool.ability: The 1st time you die, you don't.
fool.name: Fool

fortuneteller.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
fortuneteller.first: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).
fortuneteller.name: Fortune Teller
fortuneteller.other: The Fortune Teller chooses 2 players. Nod if either is the Demon (or the *RED HERRING*).

gambler.ability: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.other: The Gambler chooses a player & a character. :reminder:

gangster.ability: Once per day, you may choose to kill an alive neighbor, if your other alive neighbor agrees.
gangster.name: Gangster

gardener.ability: The Storyteller assigns all players' characters.
gardener.name: Gardener

general.ability: Each night, you learn which alignment the Storyteller believes is winning: good, evil, or neither.
general.name: General

gnome.ability: All players start knowing a player of your alignment. You may choose to kill anyone who nominates them.
gnome.name: Gnome

goblin.ability: If you publicly claim to be the Goblin when nominated & are executed that day, your team wins.
goblin.name: Goblin

godfather.ability: You start knowing which Outsiders are in play. If 1 died today, choose a player tonight: they die. [-1 or +1 Outsider]
godfather.first: Show the character tokens of all in-play Outsiders.
godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.other: If an Outsider died today, the Godfather chooses a player. :reminder:

godofug.ability: One Ug hat. When wear Ug hat, must speak one sound at a time but vote twice. If fail, pass Ug hat.
godofug.name: God of Ug

golem.ability: You may only nominate once per game. When you do, if the nominee is not the Demon, they die.
golem.name: Golem

goon.ability: Each night, the 1st player to choose you with their ability is drunk until dusk. You become their alignment.
goon.name: Goon

gossip.ability: Each day, you may make a public statement. Tonight, if it was true, a player dies.
gossip.name: Gossip
gossip.other: If the Gossip is due to kill a player, they die. :reminder:

grandmother.ability: You start knowing a good player & their character. If the Demon kills them, you die too.
grandmother.first: Point to the grandchild player & show their character token.
grandmother.name: Grandmother
grandmother.other: If the grandchild was killed by the Demon, the Grandmother dies too. :reminder:

gunslinger.ability: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
gunslinger.name: Gunslinger

harlot.ability: Each night*, choose a living player: if they agree, you learn their character, but you both might die.
harlot.name: Harlot
harlot.other: The Harlot chooses a living player. Put the Harlot to sleep. Wake the chosen player, show them the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, then the Harlot token. If that player nods their head, wake the Harlot and show them the chosen player's character token. Both players might die. :reminder: :reminder:

harpy.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is evil, or one or both might die.
harpy.first: The Harpy chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.other: The Harpy chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder: Put the Harpy to sleep. Wake the 1st target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token, the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.

hatter.ability: If you died today or tonight, the Minion & Demon players may choose new Minion & Demon characters to be.
hatter.name: Hatter
hatter.other: If the Hatter died, wake the Minions & Demons. Each may choose a new character. If they do, show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

hellslibrarian.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller has asked for silence.
hellslibrarian.name: Hell's Librarian

heretic.ability: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
heretic.name: Heretic

hermit.ability: You have all Outsider abilities. [-0 or -1 Outsider]
hermit.name: Hermit

hindu.ability: The first 4 players to die are immediately reincarnated as Travellers of the same alignment.
hindu.name: Hindu

highpriestess.ability: Each night, learn which player the Storyteller believes you should talk to most.
highpriestess.name: High Priestess

huntsman.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a living player: the Damsel, if chosen, becomes a not-in-play Townsfolk. [+the Damsel]
huntsman.first: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.
huntsman.name: Huntsman
huntsman.other: The Huntsman might choose a player. :reminder: If they chose the Damsel: Put the Huntsman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & their new character token.

imp.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.
imp.name: Imp
imp.other: The Imp chooses a player. :reminder: If the Imp chose themselves: Replace 1 alive Minion token with a spare Imp token. Put the old Imp to sleep. Wake the new Imp. Show the *YOU ARE* token, then show the Imp token.

innkeeper.ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they can't die tonight, but 1 is drunk until dusk.
innkeeper.name: Innkeeper

investigator.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
investigator.first: Show the Minion character token. Point to both the *MINION* and *WRONG* players.
investigator.name: Investigator

judge.ability: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.
judge.name: Judge

juggler.ability: On your 1st day, publicly guess up to 5 players' characters. That night, you learn how many you got correct.
juggler.name: Juggler

kazali.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [You choose which players are which Minions. -? to +? Outsiders]
kazali.first: The Kazali chooses which players are which Minions. Wake each target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
kazali.name: Kazali

king.ability: Each night, if the dead equal or outnumber the living, you learn 1 alive character. The Demon knows you are the King.
king.first: Wake the Demon: Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & King tokens, then point to the King.
king.name: King
king.other: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, show the character token of a living player.

klutz.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player: if they are evil, your team loses.
klutz.name: Klutz

knaves.ability: There are 2 Storytellers: one lies & one tells the truth. Once per game, at dusk, they might switch.
knaves.name: Knaves

knight.ability: You start knowing 2 players that are not the Demon.
knight.name: Knight

legion.ability: Each night*, a player might die. Executions fail if only evil voted. You register as a Minion too. [Most players are Legion]
legion.name: Legion

leviathan.ability: If more than 1 good player is executed, evil wins. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
leviathan.first: Announce that the Leviathan is in play. :reminder:
leviathan.name: Leviathan
leviathan.other: Change the Leviathan reminder token to the relevant day. :reminder: You may announce that the Leviathan is in play.

librarian.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
librarian.first: Show the Outsider character token. Point to both the *OUTSIDER* and *WRONG* players.
librarian.name: Librarian

lilmonsta.ability: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]
lilmonsta.first: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens.
lilmonsta.name: Lil' Monsta
lilmonsta.other: Wake the Minions. They choose a player. :reminder: Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* & Lil' Monsta tokens. A player might die. :reminder:

lleech.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. You start by choosing a player: they are poisoned. You die if & only if they are dead.
lleech.name: Lleech

lordoftyphon.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. [Evil characters are in a line. You are in the middle. +1 Minion. -? to +? Outsiders]
lordoftyphon.first: Wake the Lord of Typhon's neighbors. Show the *YOU ARE* and Minion tokens & give a thumbs-down.
lordoftyphon.name: Lord of Typhon
lordoftyphon.other: The Lord of Typhon chooses a player. :reminder:

lunatic.ability: You think you are a Demon, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are & who you choose at night.
lunatic.first: If there are 7 or more players, wake the Lunatic: Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to any players. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 good character tokens. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* info token and the Demon token. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* info token and the Lunatic token, then point to the Lunatic.
lunatic.name: Lunatic
lunatic.other: Do whatever needs to be done to simulate the Demon acting. Put the Lunatic to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the Lunatic token & point to them, then their target(s).

lycanthrope.ability: Each night*, choose an alive player. If good, they die & the Demon doesn’t kill tonight. One good player registers as evil.
lycanthrope.name: Lycanthrope

magician.ability: The Demon thinks you are a Minion. Minions think you are a Demon.
magician.first: During Minion Info, point to the Magician and the Demon. During Demon Info, point to the Magician and the Minions.
magician.name: Magician

marionette.ability: You think you are a good character, but you are not. The Demon knows who you are. [You neighbor the Demon]
marionette.first: Wake the Demon. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Marionette tokens. Point to the Marionette.
marionette.name: Marionette

mastermind.ability: If the Demon dies by execution (ending the game), play for 1 more day. If a player is then executed, their team loses.
mastermind.name: Mastermind

mathematician.ability: Each night, you learn how many players’ abilities worked abnormally (since dawn) due to another character's ability.
mathematician.name: Mathematician

matron.ability: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
matron.name: Matron

mayor.ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
mayor.name: Mayor

mezepheles.ability: You start knowing a secret word. The 1st good player to say this word becomes evil that night.
mezepheles.name: Mezepheles
mezepheles.other: If a good player said the secret word, wake the player. Show the *YOU ARE* info token & give a thumbs-down. :reminder: :reminder:

minioninfo.first: If there are 7 or more players, wake all Minions: Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the other Minions.
minioninfo.name: Minion Info

minstrel.ability: When a Minion dies by execution, all other players (except Travellers) are drunk until dusk tomorrow.
minstrel.name: Minstrel

monk.ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
monk.name: Monk

moonchild.ability: When you learn that you died, publicly choose 1 alive player. Tonight, if it was a good player, they die.
moonchild.name: Moonchild
moonchild.other: If the Moonchild is due to kill a good player, they die. :reminder:

mutant.ability: If you are “mad” about being an Outsider, you might be executed.
mutant.name: Mutant

nightwatchman.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player: they learn you are the Nightwatchman.
nightwatchman.first: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman. :reminder:
nightwatchman.name: Nightwatchman
nightwatchman.other: The Nightwatchman might choose a player. Put the Nightwatchman to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS PLAYER IS* & Nightwatchman tokens, then point to the Nightwatchman. :reminder:

noble.ability: You start knowing 3 players, 1 and only 1 of which is evil.
noble.name: Noble

nodashii.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Your 2 Townsfolk neighbors are poisoned.
nodashii.name: No Dashii
nodashii.other: The No Dashii chooses a player. :reminder:

ogre.ability: On your 1st night, choose a player (not yourself): you become their alignment (you don't know which) even if drunk or poisoned.
ogre.name: Ogre

ojo.ability: Each night*, choose a character: they die. If they are not in play, the Storyteller chooses who dies.
ojo.name: Ojo

oracle.ability: Each night*, you learn how many dead players are evil.
oracle.name: Oracle

organgrinder.ability: All players keep their eyes closed when voting and the vote tally is secret. Each night, choose if you are drunk until dusk.
organgrinder.first: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober. :reminder:
organgrinder.name: Organ Grinder
organgrinder.other: The Organ Grinder either nods their head yes to be drunk, or shakes their head no to be sober. :reminder:

pacifist.ability: Executed good players might not die.
pacifist.name: Pacifist

philosopher.ability: Once per game, at night, choose a good character: gain that ability. If this character is in play, they are drunk.
philosopher.first: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token. :reminder:
philosopher.name: Philosopher
philosopher.other: The Philosopher might choose a character. If necessary, swap their character token. :reminder:

pithag.ability: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.
pithag.name: Pit-Hag
pithag.other: The Pit-Hag chooses a player & a character. If they chose a character that is not in play: Put the Pit-Hag to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* token & their new character token.

pixie.ability: You start knowing 1 in-play Townsfolk. If you were mad that you were this character, you gain their ability when they die.
pixie.first: Show the Townsfolk character token marked *MAD*.
pixie.name: Pixie

plaguedoctor.ability: When you die, the Storyteller gains a Minion ability.
plaguedoctor.name: Plague Doctor
plaguedoctor.other: If the Plague Doctor died, the Storyteller gained a Minion ability. If you haven’t done this yet, do so now. :reminder:

po.ability: Each night*, you may choose a player: they die. If your last choice was no-one, choose 3 players tonight.
po.name: Po
po.other: The Po may choose a player OR chooses 3 players if they chose no-one last night. :reminder: or :reminder: :reminder: :reminder:

poisoner.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
poisoner.name: Poisoner

politician.ability: If you were the player most responsible for your team losing, you change alignment & win, even if dead.
politician.name: Politician

pope.ability: There are duplicate good characters in play. They might also be bluffs.
pope.name: Pope

poppygrower.ability: Minions & Demons do not know each other. If you die, they learn who each other are that night.
poppygrower.first: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
poppygrower.name: Poppy Grower
poppygrower.other: If the Poppy Grower died today or tonight, wake all Minions. Show the *THIS IS THE DEMON* token. Point to the Demon. Put the Minions to sleep. Wake the Demon. Show the *THESE ARE YOUR MINIONS* token. Point to the Minions.

preacher.ability: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.
preacher.first: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.
preacher.name: Preacher
preacher.other: The Preacher chooses a player. :reminder: If they chose a Minion: Put the Preacher to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Preacher tokens.

princess.ability: On your 1st day, if you nominated & executed a player, the Demon doesn't kill tonight.
princess.name: Princess
princess.other: If the Princess nominated the player who was executed today, wake the Demon as normal, but no one dies to the Demon's ability. :reminder:

professor.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
professor.name: Professor
professor.other: The Professor might choose a dead player. :reminder: :reminder:

psychopath.ability: Each day, before nominations, you may publicly choose a player: they die. If executed, you only die if you lose roshambo.
psychopath.name: Psychopath

pukka.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned. The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy.
pukka.name: Pukka
pukka.other: The Pukka chooses a player. :reminder: The previously poisoned player dies then becomes healthy. :reminder:

puzzlemaster.ability: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.
puzzlemaster.name: Puzzlemaster

ravenkeeper.ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
ravenkeeper.name: Ravenkeeper
ravenkeeper.other: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight, the Ravenkeeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

recluse.ability: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
recluse.name: Recluse

revolutionary.ability: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.
revolutionary.name: Revolutionary

riot.ability: On day 3, Minions become Riot & nominees die but nominate an alive player immediately. This must happen.
riot.other: Change the Riot reminder token to the relevant day. :reminder: If it is night 3, you may wake the Minions. Show the *YOU ARE* & Riot tokens.
riot.name: Riot

sage.ability: If the Demon kills you, you learn that it is 1 of 2 players.
sage.name: Sage
sage.other: If the Demon killed the Sage, wake the Sage and point to 2 players, 1 of which is the Demon.

sailor.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: either you or they are drunk until dusk. You can't die.
sailor.first: The Sailor chooses a living player. :reminder:
sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.other: The Sailor chooses a living player. :reminder:

saint.ability: If you die by execution, your team loses.
saint.name: Saint

savant.ability: Each day, you may visit the Storyteller to learn 2 things in private: 1 is true & 1 is false.
savant.name: Savant

scapegoat.ability: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
scapegoat.name: Scapegoat

scarletwoman.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
scarletwoman.name: Scarlet Woman
scarletwoman.other: If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon today, show them the *YOU ARE* token, then the Demon token.

seamstress.ability: Once per game, at night, choose 2 players (not yourself): you learn if they are the same alignment.
seamstress.first: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head. :reminder:
seamstress.name: Seamstress
seamstress.other: The Seamstress might choose 2 players. Nod or shake your head. :reminder:

sentinel.ability: There might be 1 extra or 1 fewer Outsider in play.
sentinel.name: Sentinel

shabaloth.ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
shabaloth.name: Shabaloth
shabaloth.other: A previously chosen player might be resurrected. :reminder: The Shabaloth chooses 2 players. :reminder: :reminder:

shugenja.ability: You start knowing if your closest evil player is clockwise or anti-clockwise. If equidistant, this info is arbitrary.
shugenja.name: Shugenja

slayer.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
slayer.name: Slayer

snakecharmer.ability: Each night, choose an alive player: a chosen Demon swaps characters & alignments with you & is then poisoned.
snakecharmer.first: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up. :reminder:
snakecharmer.name: Snake Charmer
snakecharmer.other: The Snake Charmer chooses a player. If they chose the Demon: Show the *YOU ARE* & Demon tokens. Give a thumbs down. Swap the Snake Charmer & Demon tokens. Put the old Snake Charmer to sleep. Wake the old Demon. Show the *YOU ARE* and Snake Charmer tokens & give a thumbs up. :reminder:

snitch.first: Wake each Minion. Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play character tokens.
snitch.name: Snitch

soldier.ability: You are safe from the Demon.
soldier.name: Soldier

spiritofivory.ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.
spiritofivory.name: Spirit of Ivory

spy.ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
spy.first: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.
spy.name: Spy
spy.other: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Spy needs.

stormcatcher.ability: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil players learn which player it is.
stormcatcher.first: Announce which character is stormcaught. If that character is in play, mark that player as *STORMCAUGHT*. Wake each evil player and show them the character token, then the marked player.  If not in play, wake each evil player, show them the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token & the relevant character token.
stormcatcher.name: Storm Catcher

summoner.ability: You get 3 bluffs. On the 3rd night, choose a player: they become an evil Demon of your choice. [No Demon]
summoner.first: Show the *THESE CHARACTERS ARE NOT IN PLAY* token. Show 3 not-in-play good character tokens.
summoner.name: Summoner
summoner.other: Change the Summoner reminder token to the relevant night. :reminder: If it is night 3, the Summoner chooses a player & a Demon character. Put the Summoner to sleep. Wake the target. Show the *YOU ARE* and Demon tokens & give a thumbs-down.

sweetheart.ability: When you die, 1 player is drunk from now on.
sweetheart.name: Sweetheart
sweetheart.other: If the Sweetheart died, a player became drunk immediately. If you haven't done this yet, do so now. :reminder:

tealady.ability: If both your alive neighbors are good, they can't die.
tealady.name: Tea Lady

thief.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
thief.name: Thief

tinker.ability: You might die at any time.
tinker.name: Tinker

tor.ability: Players don't know their character or alignment. They learn them when they die.
tor.first: Skip Minion Info and Demon Info.
tor.other: If a player died tonight, show the *YOU ARE* info token, their character token, & give a thumb signal.
tor.name: Tor

towncrier.ability: Each night*, you learn if a Minion nominated today.
towncrier.name: Town Crier
towncrier.other: Either nod or shake your head.

toymaker.ability: The Demon may choose not to attack & must do this at least once per game. Evil players get normal starting info.
toymaker.first: Resolve Minion Info and Demon Info, even though there are fewer than 7 players.
toymaker.name: Toymaker
toymaker.other: If a Demon attack could end the game, and the Demon is marked *FINAL NIGHT: NO ATTACK*, do not wake the Demon.

undertaker.ability: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
undertaker.name: Undertaker
undertaker.other: If a player was executed today, show their character token.

ventriloquist.ability: If a player is mad as a fresh character during their nomination, they might not die if executed today.
ventriloquist.name: Ventriloquist

vigormortis.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Minions you kill keep their ability & poison 1 Townsfolk neighbor. [-1 Outsider]
vigormortis.name: Vigormortis
vigormortis.other: The Vigormortis chooses a player. :reminder: If that player is a Minion, poison a neighboring Townsfolk. :reminder: :reminder:

villageidiot.ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn their alignment. [+0 to +2 Village Idiots. 1 of the extras is drunk]
villageidiot.first: If there are multiple Village Idiots, mark one as *DRUNK*. :reminder: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.
villageidiot.name: Village Idiot
villageidiot.other: Wake the Village Idiots one at a time to choose a player. Give a thumb signal.

virgin.ability: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
virgin.name: Virgin

vizier.ability: All players know you are the Vizier. You cannot die during the day. If good voted, you may choose to execute immediately.
vizier.first: Announce which player is the Vizier.
vizier.name: Vizier

vortox.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. Townsfolk abilities yield false info. Each day, if no-one is executed, evil wins.
vortox.name: Vortox

voudon.ability: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
voudon.name: Voudon

washerwoman.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
washerwoman.first: Show the Townsfolk character token. Point to both the *TOWNSFOLK* and *WRONG* players.
washerwoman.name: Washerwoman

widow.ability: On your 1st night, look at the Grimoire & choose a player: they are poisoned. 1 good player knows a Widow is in play.
widow.first: Show the Grimoire for as long as the Widow needs. The Widow chooses a player. :reminder: Put the Widow to sleep. Wake the player marked *KNOW* & show the Widow token. :reminder:
widow.name: Widow

witch.ability: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
witch.name: Witch

wizard.ability: Once per game, choose to make a wish. If granted, it might have a price & leave a clue as to its nature.
wizard.first: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.
wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.other: Do whatever needs to be done to satisfy the Wizard's ability.

wraith.ability: You may choose to open your eyes at night. You wake when other evil players do.
wraith.first: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.
wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.other: Wake the Wraith whenever other evil players wake.

xaan.ability: On night X, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk. [X Outsiders]
xaan.first: If X is 1, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token. :reminder: :reminder:
xaan.name: Xaan
xaan.other: Change the Xaan reminder token to the relevant night. If it is night X, mark the Xaan with the *X* reminder token. :reminder: :reminder:

yaggababble.ability: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you said it publicly today, a player might die.
yaggababble.first: Show the Yaggababble their secret phrase.
yaggababble.name: Yaggababble
yaggababble.other: For each time the Yaggababble said their phrase today, a player might die. :reminder:

zealot.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive, you must vote for every nomination.
zealot.name: Zealot

zenomancer.ability: One or more players each have a goal. When achieved, that player learns a piece of true info.
zenomancer.name: Zenomancer

zombuul.ability: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
zombuul.name: Zombuul
zombuul.other: If no one died today, the Zombuul chooses a player. :reminder:
